# commander_pam_database (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a **PAM database** record by **UID** or **name**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "commander_pam_database" "existing" {
  pam_database = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_UID_"
}

output "pam_database_id" {
  description = "Record UID from the data source read."
  value       = data.commander_pam_database.existing.id
}

output "pam_database_title" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.title
}

output "pam_database_hostname" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.hostname_or_ip
}

output "pam_database_use_ssl" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.use_ssl
}

output "pam_database_database_id" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.database_id
}

output "pam_database_database_type" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.database_type
}

output "pam_database_provider_group" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.provider_group
}

output "pam_database_provider_region" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.provider_region
}

output "pam_database_notes" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.notes
}

output "pam_database_folder" {
  value = data.commander_pam_database.existing.folder
}

output "pam_database_settings" {
  description = "PAM settings object (connection, tunnel, etc.)."
  value       = data.commander_pam_database.existing.pam_settings
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pam_database` (String) PAM database record **UID** or **name** to read.

### Read-Only

- `database_id` (String) **Azure or AWS Resource ID**
- `database_type` (String) **Database type** of the PAM database. Must be one of: `postgresql`, `postgresql-flexible`, `mysql`, `mysql-flexible`, `mariadb`, `mariadb-flexible`, `mssql`, `oracle`, `mongodb`.
- `folder` (String) Folder **UID** or path to store PAM database record in your Keeper vault. If not provided, the record will be stored in the root path of vault.
- `hostname_or_ip` (Attributes) **Hostname or IP address** with an optional administrative port for the PAM database. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hostname_or_ip))
- `id` (String) The PAM database record **UID** assigned by Keeper after create.
- `notes` (String) **Notes** for this PAM database record.
- `pam_settings` (Attributes) **PAM settings** for the record, including connection, tunnel, and administrative options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pam_settings))
- `provider_group` (String) **Azure or AWS Provider Group**.
- `provider_region` (String) **Azure or AWS Provider Region**.
- `title` (String) **Title** of the PAM database record.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to use **SSL** while connecting to the database resource.

<a id="nestedatt--hostname_or_ip"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hostname_or_ip`

Read-Only:

- `administrative_port` (Number) **Administrative port number** for the PAM database connection to connect on.
- `hostname` (String) **Address of the database resource**.
